summary: Resumed review by restoring exact proposal, functionality and canonical evidence reads. Both indexed changes remain supported; all nine upstream non-retain claims reconciled through corrections or accepted compiled-evidence deferrals. Supported inherited knowledge and names retained without overrides.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical construction resets three one-bit fields and stores distinct callbacks. Both selected processes invoke x18 on initial processing and x1C at animation completion. Selector 8 synchronously invokes non-null callbacks with -1 and uses the first sound argument to guard both audio calls. Direct indexing, replacement and frame-zero initialization are confirmed.

Canonical dispatch confirms terminal priority, exact symbolic outcome branches and forwarding of only the first callback. Nonzero unk_B is decremented without range validation; value 9 reaches selector 8 and therefore synchronous callback execution rather than retention. The functionality document agrees with both corrections.

contradictions.reason: The two .data attribution claims are explicitly deferred. The entry definition and initialized table support their structural and functional descriptions, but archive-string use does not prove compiled section co-location. Supported source-level knowledge is retained.

The four .sdata2 fact claims and associated link are explicitly deferred as section attributions. Attachment, animation installation and frame-zero evaluation are supported, but no compiled evidence establishes where the literal resides.

The constructor's three-byte description and conflated callback timing are corrected by proposed fact 0: these are packed one-bit flags, and initial-processing and terminal callbacks have distinct phases.

The dispatch claim's completion timing and unconditional callback retention are corrected by proposed fact 1. The ordinary first callback runs during initial processing, while override 9 reaches the synchronous selector-8 bypass.
